text.paragraph: September 22, 2025 (annual visit, Elena Marsh, MD): Fasting glucose 138 and hemoglobin A1c 6.9%: new diagnosis of type 2 diabetes. Start metformin ER 500 mg with the evening meal; referred to diabetes education. Dry cough for several months on lisinopril: stop lisinopril, start losartan 50 mg daily. Continue amlodipine 5 mg.
December 9, 2025 (follow-up, Elena Marsh, MD): Cough resolved. Blood pressure 142/88, above goal. Add hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg daily. A1c 6.7%. Return in 3 months.
June 15, 2026 (follow-up, Elena Marsh, MD): Blood pressure 128/80, at goal. A1c 6.6%. Continue current medications. Return in 6 months.
